summary: Work History Edit/Delete functionality testing complete. All 14 core features working correctly. Edit button (gear icon) and Delete button (trash icon) visible on each entry. Clicking Edit prefills form with entry data, shows 'Editing: [position]' header, Cancel button, and Save Changes button. Save updates entry in-place, form resets to add mode. Delete removes entry and cancels edit mode if editing that entry. Adding new entries works. Profile save works.

integration_issues.issue: Resume-parsed work history entries use different field names (primary_employer, role_title, display_title) than the edit form expects (facility_name, position). When editing such entries, form shows empty fields.

issues: Console warnings about date format mismatch. Existing entries have dates in 'MM/YYYY' format but HTML5 month input expects 'yyyy-MM'. Does not break functionality but shows console warnings.

passed_tests: Work History tab: Edit button (gear icon) visible on each entry - data-testid='edit-work-0', 'edit-work-1'
Work History tab: Delete button (trash icon) visible on each entry - data-testid='delete-work-0', 'delete-work-1'
Clicking Edit prefills form with entry data (facility, position, department, dates, responsibilities)
Form header changes to 'Editing: [position]' when in edit mode
Cancel button appears in edit mode - data-testid='cancel-edit-work'
Save Changes button appears (replaces 'Add Work Experience') - data-testid='save-work-btn'
Add Work Experience button hidden in edit mode
Save Changes updates existing entry in-place (not adding duplicate)
After saving changes, form resets to add mode ('Add Work Experience')
Delete button removes entry from list
If editing an entry and deleting it, edit mode is cancelled
Edited entry shows updated data immediately after saving
Adding new entry works normally in non-edit mode
Edited entry highlighted with primary border while being edited
Profile save works after editing work history entries - 'Profile saved successfully' toast shown
No runtime errors during edit/save/delete operations (except date format warnings)
